family: All ordered pairs of Boolean functions on two data bits, with every quadratic F2 phase on two independent control bits; then prescribed weak/unequal threshold pairs
symmetry: none; ordered data pairs, constant/linear/quadratic terms all retained

notes: No finite check proves the all-dimensional theorem; the report derives it algebraically. Timeout is an unresolved computation, not a mathematical counterexample.
